gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-old-persia: Luckiest Guy shouts cheerfully, its ink looking poured at one width and its mean line set high above the rest. Noto Sans Old Persian is the quiet one, a plain sans with tall lowercase and counters that breathe.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdia: Luckiest Guy is loud and cheerful, every stem and arch cut at identical thickness. And Noto Sans Old Sogdian stays crisp beside it, its tall x-height holding up even when you shrink it down.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Noto Sans Old Turkic is approachable, chunky and tall in the lowercase. Luckiest Guy sits over it like a fixed pen drawing loud, cheerful strokes, while the body's open-mouthed curves keep everything clear underneath.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Loud, cheerful and top-heavy with attitude. Luckiest Guy brings a high mean line and an o drawn with equally thick sides, while Noto Sans Oriya wins on generous gaps in its curves and small letters nearly as tall as capitals.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-osage: Cheerful from the first letter, Luckiest Guy pours its ink out at stem thickness with bowls to match and a mean line set high. Noto Sans Osage follows with lowercase bowls that fill the line like inflated shapes, and sweeping curves that never close up.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Noto Sans Osmanya reads clean and professional, with wide, easy turns in its s and lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. Luckiest Guy sits above it with no hairlines and no swells anywhere, loud and cheerful, a mean line set high.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmo: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong reads neutral and contemporary, with a high-set x-height and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle. Luckiest Guy is best at loud, thick-outlined cheer with a mean line set high, while Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong does the quieter work of staying easy to read.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Luckiest Guy is cheerful and loud, its letters cut out like a fixed-width router bit with a mean line set high. Noto Sans Palmyrene does the modern, clean work instead, with curves that stop short of closing in and compressed ascenders.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-ha: Cheerful, loud and glowing like neon tube. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau follows with open-ended curves that breathe and only a short step from lowercase top to capital top, so Luckiest Guy's mean, high line gets a modern, clean companion.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Flat, contrast-free letterforms, poured at one width with a mean line set high and an e that opens clearly to the right, make Luckiest Guy loud. Noto Sans PhagsPa hands over see-through c openings and a gentle bump up to capitals.
